notices.lead: A wrong takedown has a price.
notices.body: Under 17 U.S.C. 512(f), anyone who knowingly files a false takedown claim is liable for the damages and legal fees the other side suffers. File only for work you own, and only after you have looked at both games yourself.
Roblox Rights Manager has no public API. DMCA Daemon prepares the evidence and the notice; you file it in Creator Hub under Intellectual Property.

notes: Identical image: one of their images has the very same bytes as one of yours (equal sha256). That shows the same file was used, not who made it first.
Near-identical image: the closest image pair differs by 2 or fewer of 64 hash bits and the names are at least 50% similar. This is a perceptual match, not identical bytes.
Needs review: the closest image pair differs by 10 or fewer of 64 hash bits, or the names are at least 75% similar and the descriptions at least 50% similar.
Weak signal: the closest image pair differs by 16 or fewer of 64 hash bits, or the descriptions are at least 35% similar. Only the strongest 8 are listed.
